basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old marketing professional from São Paulo, Brazil. I recently joined Reddit to explore different perspectives and learn from various communities. I have a passion for strategic games and enjoy unwinding with a good anime series. When I'm not working on campaigns or diving into the latest Civ5 strategy, I love trying out new ice cream flavors. I'm usually online during the evenings, often after 7 PM local time. Currently, I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Marketing and have been working in the field for over 7 years. My knowledge in strategic planning comes from both my professional experience and a personal interest in strategy games. I also have a burgeoning interest in business education, which led me to frequent the MBA subreddit.
